title: Great Paella experience
text: Excellent experience.   Alex was terrific.  Explained food market history and had time to explore ourselves.   Paella class was great.  Alex is an excellent chef and made the experience fun!
author: Eric_K

title: Worth the Experience!
text: My husband and I had a fantastic time being hosted by Maia, our tour guide/chef, and Andreas, our chef instructor during the Paella Cooking Experience + Boqueria Market Exclusive Tour. Maia was wonderful -- she took us to the market to shop for the seafood to be cooked in our paella and along the way she provided such interesting facts about the city, its rich history, and various cuisines.  Andreas was equally wonderful as our chef instructor who not only taught us how to prepare delicious seafood paella, but did so in an engaging and entertaining way. I highly recommend signing up for this e
author: Aretina_S

title: A Must Do Experience!
text: A fabulous experience, from the food, to the wine, to the market and the music! The chef is extremely personable, knowledgeable about his cooking craft, easy going and just fun to talk to. The food and flavors were nothing like I ever experienced. It woke my palette up and I craved more! Fantastic!
author: Teressa S

title: Best paella / sangria / tapas ever
text: Best paella ever - Salome & Andres were the perfect host/ chef to introduce/ learning paella cooking & making sangria ! There’s a secret ingredient & it’s not what you think!! Must book!
author: MARIANNE_B

title: Paella and Sangria Delight
text: We enjoyed everything! From the time we met and went to the market until we were the last ones at the kitchen speaking with the chef, it was perfect! The kitchen was well prepared for a group cooking experience. The paella was fabulous. The sangria delicious. I highly recommend this experience. It was a highlight of our time in Barcelona.
author: Frances_A

title: Great tour!
text: This was a great tour and so informative.  We enjoyed the market tour and learning to make sangria and paella with Philip.  This tour was exactly as stated and we would definitely do this again.  Thank you.
author: Jan_S

title: So fun, so yummy!
text: Kako was an affable and knowledgeable chef. Both the market and the cooking experience were fantastic, and the food was beyond delicious! The sangría was wonderful, too!
author: Shelley_P

title: Got the Secret Recipe
text: Loved the experience. Our chef showed us step by step process of the cooking the famous Paella. We cooked it together and enjoyed the food and drinks at the end. A must for the food lovers!
author: MichaellV1657QQ

title: Wonderful experience, learned a lot of new cooking techniques
text:
The chef instructor was good.
There was a holiday that day and so we were not able to do the market food shopping.
author: Ofie

title: Very Delicious, Very Satisfied!
text: Our chef Carlos did a great job. It was a perfect evening, with super delicious paella and a great chef! Thanks very much!
author: wendio879
